title: Open-Healing Socket Preservation with a Novel Dense Polytetrafluoroethylene (dPTFE) Membrane: A Retrospective Clinical Study
authors: Zafiropoulos GG, Kačarević ZP, Qasim SSB, Trajkovski B. 2020. Medicina (Kaunas). 2020 Apr;56(5):216. doi: 10.3390/medicina56050216.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The use of the examined new dPTFE membrane consistently led to the preservation of hard tissue in the extraction sites” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
